recognize_zh: 臨床照片可見大腿與小腿皮膚大片壞死性潰瘍及周邊皮下結節（A、E 箭頭），PET/CT 顯示鼻腔、脾臟與皮下病灶 FDG 高攝取（B–E），呈現 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤合併皮膚與全身侵犯的臨床樣貌；這不是顯微鏡圖，確診仍需組織切片。
features: Panel A: large necrotic ulcer with a rolled erythematous border and surrounding induration on the thigh, plus additional subcutaneous nodules (arrows), and a separate ulcer on the lower leg
Panel B: PET/CT with intense FDG uptake in the nasal cavity
Panel C: axial chest PET/CT with intense uptake in a left upper abdominal organ (spleen) and small measured nodes
Panel D: coronal PET/CT with markedly FDG-avid enlarged spleen
Panel E: subtle subcutaneous nodule of the lower leg (arrow) with focal FDG uptake on PET
describe_en: This composite of clinical photographs and PET/CT images is not morphologic. It shows necrotic ulcerated skin lesions and subcutaneous nodules on the lower limbs, with FDG-avid disease in the nasal cavity, spleen, and subcutaneous tissue of the leg, indicating extranasal and disseminated involvement. These appearances are suggestive of extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma with cutaneous and systemic spread, but they are not specific; biopsy of a lesion showing an angiocentric, necrotizing infiltrate of atypical cells positive for cytoplasmic CD3, CD56, cytotoxic granule proteins, and EBER is required for diagnosis, and plasma EBV DNA is useful for monitoring.

ddx.vs: It also forms ulcerated nodules on the extremities but lacks EBV (EBER negative) and expresses TCR gamma-delta.
SPTCL forms subcutaneous nodules that rarely ulcerate, with rimming of adipocytes by alpha-beta CD8+ cells that are EBER and CD56 negative.

ddx.dx: Pyoderma gangrenosum or ecthyma from infection
ddx.vs: These produce similar necrotic ulcers but biopsy shows neutrophilic inflammation or organisms without an atypical EBV-positive cytotoxic lymphoid infiltrate or nasal and splenic FDG-avid disease.
